quest.title: Where Is the Unseen Razor?
quest.description: Lan has been looking for a certain sword. Her search has not been fruitful, so she's decided to widen her search range.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: *sigh* Still nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two again. Clearly there aren't enough guild quests to keep you occupied.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: If you are interested, I have another Commission you could take?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: A group of Hilichurl Shooters has congregated in the middle of Guili Plains and are threatening passers-by.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: They may only be hilichurls, but there are a lot of them and they have the higher ground. The average adventurer would be helpless against them.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I need you to dispose of them, quickly and efficiently. Afterwards, there will be ample compensation waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Also — if you come across anything to do with a sword, anything at all, please bring it back to me.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: I can't tell whether your eagerness to take this on is born out of youthful naivety or boundless courage...

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: But if I'm sure about one thing, it's that you truly have an Adventurer's spirit.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: That's all I have to say. It's time for you to get ready.

choices.text: What does the sword mean to these hilichurls?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Nothing, the two are unrelated. All I need you to do is keep an eye out for it — if you find something, bring it back. If not, it's no problem.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The objective of this Commission is to defeat the hilichurls. Defeat them, and you will get your reward.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Have you defeated the Hilichurl Shooters yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Is that because you're preparing meticulously, or because you're dragging your heels?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: ...Or is it a little from column A, a little from column B?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Have you defeated the Hilichurl Shooters yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Good job. I hope they didn't give you too much trouble? No, I didn't think they would... just asking to be polite.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Still nothing on the sword? *sigh* Surprise, surprise... a futile search once again...

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Thank you, anyway. Here is your compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you preoccupied with this sword?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: ...I suppose there's no harm in telling you. Its name is Unseen Razor. My older brother was its proud owner.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: But inexplicably, it was not found on his person when he passed away.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: He always had that sword with him. Always. So for something to happen that separated him from it... It's bothered me ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, I've never found a single solid lead on where the sword might be, or what he encountered before he died.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: That's it, really. There's nothing more to say. Except have a nice day.
